lines.en: One stride takes me past two stretches of corridor.
When you look back, I am no longer where I was.
You cannot guess my route.
I cling to the ceiling, flickering in and out.
The moment I pass through a wall is very quick.
There are no prints of mine on the floor.

lines.zh: 我挪动的方式像坏掉的影像。
lines.en: I shift like a broken image.
I have gone from this end to that one.

lines.zh: 我前一刻在左，下一刻在右。
lines.en: A moment ago I was left; now I am right.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的距离对我不算数。
lines.en: Distance in this room means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我靠近的速度越来越快。
lines.en: The speed of my approach keeps increasing.
I skip the middle portion of the path.

lines.zh: 我停着，画面也停了一格。
lines.en: I stop, and the picture skips a frame.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，只是还没动。
lines.en: I am behind you, only not yet moving.
The edges of this body are shivering.
I count the heartbeats in this room.
The light flickered twice. I did not leave.
I keep to the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我不需要站着也能存在。
lines.en: I need not stand to exist.
My outline does not always line up.

lines.zh: 这里的墙对我是开着的。
lines.en: The walls here are open to me.
I wait for the flicker.
You looked the wrong way again.
I am quite quiet, though you would not say so.
I look most human when I am still.
I am between two positions.

lines.zh: 你现在看我，我已经换地方了。
lines.en: You look at me, and I have already moved.
Do not bother memorizing where I am.
Your eyes are slower than I am.
The me from three seconds ago is long gone.
I am always at the edge of your vision.
Can you count how many times you blink?

lines.zh: 你听见的是回声，不是脚步。
lines.en: What you hear is an echo, not footsteps.
Do you think that was me just now?
I occupy more than one position.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的规则我说了算。
lines.en: The rules of this room are mine.
Will you go forward, or back?
I am a little faster than last time.
Where your gaze lands, I scatter.
There is no distance between us.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作我提前看见了。
lines.en: I saw your hand lift before it did.
You are already running in your mind.

lines.zh: 我会从你最想不到的地方来。
lines.en: I will come from where you least expect.
Do not turn off the light. It only gets worse.
How long have you been standing there?
I never come in order.
I flickered and came back.
What you hit was an afterimage.
My shape briefly came apart.
That cost me a single frame.
You guessed my position wrong.
I retreated to the far side of the wall.

lines.zh: 灯光明亮了一瞬，你看见了。
lines.en: The light sharpened for an instant, and you saw.
I have moved off this corridor.

lines.zh: 你听见的不是我的声音。
lines.en: What you heard was not my voice.
I am still faster than you.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: You raise it. I have seen it.

lines.zh: 供品摆好了，我还是朝你走。
lines.en: The offering is laid out and I still walk toward you.
Your hand trembles as you set it down.
That is for the living.
You call this an offering? Too late.

lines.zh: 气味在空气里散得太慢。
lines.en: The smell disperses too slowly in this air.
I circle it half way.

lines.zh: 我不伸手，你自己放近点。
lines.en: I will not reach out. Bring it closer yourself.
This will not make me stop.
Does holding it make you feel safe?

lines.zh: 你撞上的那一刻我已经走了。
lines.en: When you struck, I had already gone.
Your shoulder met empty space.
I am pressed against your back.
That touch took away your sense of direction.
Your hand went through my shadow.
The time we overlapped was very short.
You turned twice on the spot.
The angles of the room have changed.

lines.zh: 走廊从我这边折过去了。
lines.en: The corridor folded away on my side.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，走廊抖了一下。
lines.en: When we collide, the corridor shudders.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以从不落后。
lines.en: I need no breath, so I never fall behind.
The distance between us keeps shortening.
I follow you without needing a reason.
You may stop. I will not.
We share these corridors.

lines.zh: 我记住你转弯的方式了。
lines.en: I remember how you take a corner.
When you turn, I am standing there.

lines.zh: 我们两个的路线已经重叠。
lines.en: Our paths have begun to overlap.
You are here; so am I.

lines.zh: 别关那扇门，我会从窗进来。
lines.en: Do not shut that door. I will come through the window.
I took it from your hand.

lines.zh: 你回头时它已经不在了。
lines.en: When you turned, it was gone.
I need not touch to take.

lines.zh: 它现在在我手里，看不清。
lines.en: It is in my hand now, indistinct.

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西都会到我这儿。
lines.en: Everything dropped comes to me.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，已经在我兜里。
lines.en: The thing you set down is already in my pocket.
You will not find it again.
This will be useful to me.
It still holds your warmth.
I have squeezed it out of shape.

lines.zh: 你已经在我选的房间里了。
lines.en: You are already in the room I chose.

lines.zh: 门刚才响过，你听见了吗？
lines.en: The door made a sound. Did you hear it?
Whichever door you choose, I arrive first.
This time I take no detours.

lines.zh: 这栋楼没有出口，我问过了。
lines.en: This building has no exit. I checked.
There is no way out through the window either.
Faster than the void, and harder to predict.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我数得很清楚。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat distinctly.

lines.zh: 我选了你，因为你停下了。
lines.en: I chose you because you stopped.
I have sealed all three corridors.
We are done playing hide.
You may drop that lamp.
As I come near, you will misjudge.

lines.zh: 你刚才看见的那个不是我。
lines.en: That thing you saw was not me.

lines.zh: 现在开始，我在每一步旁边。
lines.en: From here on, I am beside every step.
The path you chose is the shortest.
I am ahead of you, and also behind.

lines.zh: 我快得连残影都来不及留下。
lines.en: I move too fast to leave even an afterimage.
The one in the mirror is me too.
I'm harder to predict than the void.
There is no door at the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我贴着天花板跟了半间屋。
lines.en: I have trailed you half the room along the ceiling.
Your lamp only reaches my feet.

lines.zh: 我每出现一次，就更近一些。
lines.en: Each time I appear, I am a little nearer.
You are going in circles.

lines.zh: 你听见的那三下是假的。
lines.en: Those three knocks were false.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，你可以听。
lines.en: I need not breathe; you may listen.

lines.zh: 你的后面一直空着，现在不空了。
lines.en: Behind you was empty. It is not now.
The doorknob turned again.

lines.zh: 你走的路和来时不一样。
lines.en: The way you walk is not the way you came.

lines.zh: 你每跑一步，我换一次位置。
lines.en: Each step you run, I change position once.

lines.zh: 屋子变窄的速度在加快。
lines.en: The room is narrowing faster than before.

lines.zh: 你看到的影子比我的多。
lines.en: You see more shadows than I cast.
I show only a little at a time.

lines.zh: 距离这个说法已经没意义了。
lines.en: The word distance has lost its meaning.
The last step is always the shortest.

lines.zh: 我从你的视线死角出来。
lines.en: I come from your blind spot.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀被什么东西压住。
lines.en: Something bears down on your shoulder.
Your foot has sunk into the floor.
It was so fast there was no sound.
There is one more of me in front of you.
Your weapon struck air twice.
The shadow on the wall moved first.

lines.zh: 你被拖到了另一个房间。
lines.en: You have been dragged into another room.

lines.zh: 地板和天花板换了位置。
lines.en: The floor and ceiling have traded places.
You taste dust.

lines.zh: 你伸手过去，什么也没有。
lines.en: You reach out and find nothing.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，又松开。
lines.en: I catch your arm and let go.
You stood in the corridor a long time.

lines.zh: 现在你分不清哪边是前。
lines.en: Now you cannot tell which way is forward.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子已经不一样了。
lines.en: This room is no longer the same.

lines.zh: 我说过我会从想不到的地方来。
lines.en: I told you I would come from the unexpected place.
Half the corridor lights went out first.

lines.zh: 你还没转身，我已经站在另一头。
lines.en: Before you turn, I am standing at the other end.
Two knocks, very close together.

lines.zh: 地板下传来跑动的声音。
lines.en: Running sounds come from under the floor.
I slide down out of a wall.
The clock in the room is running backwards.
The air suddenly cooled a notch.

lines.zh: 你身后的空间多了一块。
lines.en: A new space has appeared behind you.

lines.zh: 画面跳了一下，我就到了。
lines.en: The picture skipped, and there I was.
The door did not open, yet I came in.
Outside the window is black as a wall.
I stand between two lamps.

lines.zh: 地板上的灰聚成一条线。
lines.en: Dust on the floor gathers into a line.
I show myself far off first.
The lamplight shrinks to a small circle.

lines.zh: 我比 Void 更没规律。
lines.en: I'm less predictable than the Void.

lines.zh: 灯每闪一次，我就换一处站。
lines.en: Every time the light flickers, I stand somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我的位置就变。
lines.en: Count to three, and my position changes.

lines.zh: 我来了，从最不可能的角度。
lines.en: I have come, from the least likely angle.
The room's clock has finished striking.
The fire makes the shadows too clear.

lines.zh: 你掉下去的时候，我在下面仰头。
lines.en: As you fell, I looked up from below.

lines.zh: 水涨起来，房间没有出口。
lines.en: The water rose, and the room had no exit.

lines.zh: 爆炸的光把我推远了一点。
lines.en: The blast's light pushed me further off.

lines.zh: 你射中的是墙上的影子。
lines.en: You shot the shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我停了一瞬。
lines.en: That force held me for an instant.
I have chased a long while and never caught it.

lines.zh: 整条走廊白了一瞬，我被看见了。
lines.en: The whole corridor went white, and I was seen.

lines.zh: 这里和虚空差不多，我更自在。
lines.en: This is like the void. I am more at home.
